messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: customer=Silvershore private-vpc: spike in outbound failures from NLB -> external services (443). 30% of requests returning timeout/connection errors. Auto-escalation to #incidents.
Jade (oncall): acknowledging, oncall taking. tagging Marcus and Liu.
Jade (oncall): Emily/Sam can you confirm customer impact? what errors are they seeing in app?
Emily (SE): customer's inference calls time out after ~6s, they see 502/timeout in app logs. Reports started ~ 09:02 UTC.
Sam (AM): pinged customer, they're seeing degraded UX across a subset of hosts. Customer says only private deployment affected, hosted unaffected.
Marcus - NetOps: I'm looking at NLB targets + SGs. Quick findings: a recent maintenance change appears to have tightened outbound SG egress on the worker security group (sg-0a1b2c3d).
Marcus - NetOps: NLB health: some targets show 503/failed health checks. NAT gateway metrics show increased ErrorCount and ConnectionErrors.
Liu (SRE): can we get tcpdump from a failing node? Jade, please pick a host and run capture.
Jade (oncall): grabbing host: silv-worker-12. running: `sudo tcpdump -nn -i eth0 'tcp and (dst port 443 or dst port 80)' -c 200 -w /tmp/silv-443.pcap`
Jade (oncall): also running `curl -v https://api.external-service.example.com/health` from the host to validate egress.
Jade (oncall): curl shows `connect to 198.51.100.45 port 443: Connection timed out`
Marcus - NetOps: looks like egress is blocked at SG level — outbound rules only allow 443 to a small CIDR that excludes the partner IPs. config drift during patch window?
Emily (SE): customer says they recently asked for tighter egress controls (allowlist) but account team didn't authorize a full cutoff. they expected NAT-based filtering, not host-level deny.
Sam (AM): noted, Sam to keep customer updated.
Liu (SRE): mitigation plan: 1) add temporary outbound rule to worker SG to allow 0.0.0.0/0:443 for the customer tenant instances (emergency window). 2) failover NLB traffic to backup subnet (if available). 3) schedule proper allowlist with customer for permanent fix.
Jade (oncall): Marcus, can you add the temp rule and post the exact command so we have audit trail?
Marcus - NetOps: running change: `aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-0a1b2c3d --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 0.0.0.0/0 --description "temp emergency outbound 443 for incident 1749123456"`
Marcus - NetOps: change pushed, waiting for propagation.
ops-runner-bot: change logged: CHANGE_ID=chg-20240309-9876 by Marcus - NetOps.
Jade (oncall): re-run curl from silv-worker-12
Jade (oncall): curl now returns 200 OK, partner health endpoint reachable.
Emily (SE): customer confirms calls recovered on their side. seeing reduced timeouts in their app.
Liu (SRE): monitor NLB target health and application error rate for 15m. set alert if >5% errors resume.
Marcus - NetOps: NLB target health resync in progress, most targets now healthy. NAT gateway errors dropping to baseline.
Jade (oncall): temporary rule will remain for 30 minutes while Sam coordinates with customer for proper allowlist. we'll rotate to more restrictive CIDR once partner provides IP ranges.
Sam (AM): I've set a call with customer in 20m to confirm allowlist and get partner IP ranges. I'll update here with CIDRs to apply.
Emily (SE): follow-up: check route tables — discovered a route update in the same maintenance window that flipped a minority of hosts to a route table missing the NAT association. Marcus, please include in RCA.
Marcus - NetOps: noted, collecting CloudTrail and config history now:`aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters Name=association.subnet-id,Values=subnet-0abcde` and `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=rtb-0f1e2d3c`
Liu (SRE): post-incident actions: 1) run a script to detect SG egress mismatches against baseline for private deployments. 2) add a pre-merge test to infra repo that prevents SG rollback during maintenance. 3) include NAT-association verification in deployment playbook.
Jade (oncall): setting interim incident severity to Sev2 (customer-facing degraded, workaround applied).
incident-bot: Pager acknowledged: page sent to oncall at 09:05 UTC.
Jade (oncall): thanks all. I'll keep watch for 30m then start handoff notes for tomorrow rotation. Marcus, Liu, please collect logs and timeline for postmortem. Sam/Emily, continue customer comms.
Sam (AM): customer on call, they asked for an ETA for permanent fix. telling them we'll apply allowlist changes after we get partner IP list; ETA ~1-2 hours.
Marcus - NetOps: collecting `describe-security-groups`, `describe-nat-gateways`, CloudWatch logs, and NLB target group health snapshots.
Liu (SRE): adding runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/privnet-egress-incident — follow for RCA template.
Jade (oncall): closing thread for active mitigation — reopening if errors spike. :white_check_mark:
ops-runner-bot: INCIDENT 1749123456 status=mitigated by temporary SG rule; logs collected to s3://redwood-incidents/1749123456/
